llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam indicators: 1) extremely low prices for branded Salomon items, 2) no legitimate company details, 3) generic and unprofessional contact information, 4) vague privacy and business info, 5) whois shows registration to a private individual in China, not the real corporate owner, 6) new domain with no history of genuine business activity, and 7) domain uses parking nameservers, suggesting possible domain resale. These traits match scam characteristics involving fake e-commerce sites designed to deceive consumers.
